claim_boundary: Observed effects are exploratory incremental prompt-package effects for eight development speakers. They are not human-validated Persona Fidelity, semantic reliability, independent validation, or confirmatory population inference.
effect_definition: with x_j=2*factor_j-1, every nonempty subset A is 2*mean(y*product(x_j)); a main effect is mean(factor=1)-mean(factor=0), and interactions use the same Hadamard product coding

measurement_validity.copying: surface reuse diagnostic; copying is not Persona Fidelity
measurement_validity.reference_overlap: lexical resemblance to one observed continuation; not correctness
measurement_validity.style_proxy: secondary mixed stylometric proxy; one short response is unstable

style_validity_interpretive_evidence.supported_claim: Development-only evidence about whether the observed mixed surface/stylometric signal survives finite confounding controls.
unsupported_claims: stable speaker identity independent of topic

uncertainty: Speaker-level range and leave-one-speaker-out mean range are descriptive influence summaries, not confidence intervals; no confirmatory p-values.
